notes: §1985:XIV.2.2.4 GR19: the MCS takes the text length as "the number of leftmost character positions of the data item referenced by the identifier" to transfer (with §1985:XIV.3.6.4 GR3: zero transfers nothing, outside zero..size is an error). MessageControlSession.Send reads CommunicationArea.TextLength, refuses a length past the operand's size (or non-numeric) with 50 and a zero-length portion with no indicator with 60, and sends text[..textLength]. Probes at 85: lengths 0 (EMI and none), 10, 11, non-numeric, ref-mod MSG (7:4) with 4 and 5, a group with a signed item, FUNCTION UPPER-CASE, indicator item 0/1/2/9 and no FROM, read back by RECEIVE with the right lengths; the witness sends 5, 10, 1 of 10.

next.reason: 1985: "the MCS will interpret the content of the data item referenced by data-name-2 to be the user's indication of the number of"; 2023: "No candidate covers the communication description entry, the MCS or SEND; the communication module is absent from 2023.". The rule covers the CD entry, MCS and SEND text length. No 2023 clause holds this feature, and the candidates cover only file, sort, data, report and screen entries.
